name: serverless
description: The Serverless Framework skill for AI coding agents: build, deploy and operate applications on AWS Lambda with serverless.yml and the serverless CLI.

interface.longDescription: Gives your agent the Serverless Framework skill: how to write serverless.yml, deploy and operate services on AWS with the serverless CLI, develop against live AWS events, and read the documentation that ships with the CLI. In a project, the skill has the agent run "serverless agent setup", which adds the feature skills for Dev Mode, MCP servers on AWS Lambda, sandboxes and upgrades to v4.
defaultPrompt: Create a Serverless Framework service with an HTTP API and a DynamoDB table
Deploy this service to a dev stage and show me its endpoints
Find out why my last serverless deploy failed
